build_wav2vec2_asr_model: build a Wav2Vec2AsrModel with a transformer encoder, frontend, and final projection layer
run_wav2vec2_asr_inference: run the Wav2Vec2AsrModel forward pass on audio sequences to get logits and batch layout
run_wav2vec2_asr_training: run the Wav2Vec2AsrModel forward pass with targets to compute CTC loss for training
review_wav2vec2_asr_forward: review the Wav2Vec2AsrModel forward method to understand CTC loss computation and log softmax
refactor_wav2vec2_asr_masker: refactor the Wav2Vec2AsrModel to customize the Wav2Vec2Masker used during training
